question_text: The Governor's discretionary powers have frequently strained Centre-State relations. Critically examine the constitutional safeguards and judicial remedies available to maintain federal balance.
Examine the scope of Right to Privacy as a Fundamental Right under Article 21 in the light of the landmark Puttaswamy judgment and digital surveillance concerns.
The Basic Structure Doctrine acts as an essential safety valve against parliamentary majoritarianism. Discuss with reference to Kesavananda Bharati and Minerva Mills cases.
Discuss the functioning of the GST Council as a mechanism for cooperative fiscal federalism in India, keeping in view the Supreme Court ruling in Mohit Minerals case.
The Tenth Schedule has failed to curb political defections and horse-trading. Critically analyze the role and powers of the Speaker in this regard citing Kihoto Hollohan.
Frequent repromulgation of ordinances by the executive undermines parliamentary democracy. Elucidate with reference to Article 123 and D.C. Wadhwa case.
An independent Election Commission is indispensable for free and fair elections. Examine the implications of the Anoop Baranwal judgment on appointment of election commissioners.
Implementing a Uniform Civil Code under Article 44 requires balancing gender justice with religious freedom under Article 25. Discuss.
Critically examine the constitutional status of the National Capital Territory of Delhi under Article 239AA and the Supreme Court rulings on control over civil services.
Highlight the key recommendations of the Second Administrative Reforms Commission (2nd ARC) on Ethics in Governance to tackle bureaucratic corruption.
